chunks: The right of the one who seeks advice (mustashir) is that, if you know he has a good opinion, you advise him to follow it, and if you do not know, you direct him to someone who does.
ai.seo_question: What is the proper etiquette for giving advice in Islam?
ai.summary: Imam Zayn al-Abidin (AS) establishes the principle of intellectual humility and professional integrity in consultation (istisharah), distinguishing between validating a sound opinion and recognizing one's own limitations. This reflects the Shia emphasis on seeking expertise (ahl al-khbar) when one lacks specific knowledge, ensuring that advice is both accurate and beneficial to the community.
